messages:
sophia: Heads-up We need to finalize the v1->v2 migration playbook this sprint. I pushed a PR with an end-to-end checklist and a couple of example snippets: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2033 :spiral_notepad:

ryan: Reviewing now. Quick Q: are we doing redirects at path level or query param level? ops prefers path-level so CDNs can cache 301s.

tasha: Path-level is cleaner. Also: include exact stderr logs developers will grep for so support can triage without reproducing.

emily: I'll add the logs. Also suggestion: add a tiny Ruby snippet showing the v1->v2 client name change and the exact exception class thrown.

sophia: Good — copy for Ruby exception I captured earlier:

```
# Ruby SDK v1 -> v2
begin
  resp = client.complete(prompt)
rescue Redwood::DeprecatedEndpointError => e
  puts "deprecated: #{e.message}"
end
```

infra-bot: Reminder: include an infra contact for rollback and set an ica ticket template in the playbook.

ryan: On the model-swap side, note that embed alias `embed-lite` will switch from 1024->1536 dims. We must ship a migration snippet that pads old vectors and documents cosine behavior.

emily: I can draft TypeScript and Python examples. Idea: provide a helper pad_vector(vec, target_dim) with a short note about normalization variance.

sophia: Please add a short test that decodes an example vector and asserts len == target_dim in snippets CI. We should fail the docs build if examples break.

ryan: For rollout timeline: ops wants canary (5% redirect) for 48h, then 100% after sign-off. legal asked for an FAQ blurb about billing impacts. We should put a banner link to the FAQ and the migration guide.

tasha: I'll write the FAQ blurb. Also propose a small "compat shim" snippet in docs: how to alias old model id to a compatibility fallback via server-side mapping. Keep it marked experimental.

emily: Here's a minimal Python pad + fallback example I'll add to the PR:

```
# python embed fallback
def pad_vector(v, target=1536):
    if len(v) >= target:
        return v[:target]
    return v + [0.0] * (target - len(v))

def embed_with_fallback(model_alias, text):
    try:
        return api.embed(model=model_alias, input=text)
    except ApiError as e:
        if 'dimension mismatch' in str(e):
            fallback = 'embed-legacy'
            vec = api.embed(model=fallback, input=text)
            return pad_vector(vec, target=1536)
        raise
```

docs-bot: Please add labels: `migration`, `deprecation`, `needs-smoke`. CI will run snippet lint and example tests on push.

sophia: Let's set the merge target to Friday noon. After merge: (1) post in #announcements with migration link, (2) create a support playbook snippet, (3) trigger the redirect canary. I'll draft the announcement copy.

ryan: I'll coordinate the canary with infra. Tagging @infra on the PR.

tasha: One more: include an explicit callout in the guide for customers using dedicated/private deployments; steps differ (no forced redirects). Add a checklist item to contact AE for private plans.

emily: will add HEADERS note for SDKs about the new `X-Redwood-Client: v2` header so proxies can route.

sophia: Amazing. Thanks team  I'll update PR 2033 with the Ruby exception, emily's snippets, the FAQ stub, and the rollout checklist. Ping here when ready for final pass. :raised_hands:
